symbols.name: stored bit volume
symbols.meaning: The number of data bits the array holds.
symbols.quote: $V$ is the stored bit volume, the number of data bits the array holds.

symbols.name: field width
symbols.meaning: The number of address bits in one field.
symbols.quote: $u$ is the width of each field, the number of address bits in one field; the letter $u$ changes meaning here.

symbols.name: cost exponent
symbols.meaning: A fixed exponent in the cost bound, with $0<\tau<1$.

symbols.name: wire count
symbols.meaning: The number of wires of the network, scratch wires included.
symbols.quote: Its $W$ wires, scratch wires included, each carry rows of volume $V/W$.

symbols.name: edge
symbols.meaning: An edge of the network, the wire segment between two consecutive vertices.
symbols.quote: Each edge $e$ changes that shear by $G_e$, the difference of its end-vertex matrices, by the interchanges above.

symbols.name: edge matrix change
symbols.meaning: The difference of the end-vertex matrices of edge e, by which the frame changes along e.
symbols.quote: Each edge $e$ changes that shear by $G_e$, the difference of its end-vertex matrices, by the interchanges above.

symbols.name: matrix size
symbols.meaning: The number of rows and columns of each matrix of the network.
symbols.quote: Let $\beta\ge2$ be the size of the network's matrices; a field splits into $\beta$ pieces of width $u/\beta$.

symbols.name: total edge rank
symbols.meaning: The sum of the edge matrix ranks, which counts the recursive calls in one level.
symbols.quote: Summing over edges, one level makes $R=\sum_e\operatorname{rank}G_e$ calls, each on volume $V/W$ and width $u/\beta$.

symbols.name: time per stored bit
symbols.meaning: The running time at width u divided by the stored bit volume.
symbols.quote: Let $\varphi(u)$ be the time per stored bit at width $u$.

symbols.name: level constant
symbols.meaning: A constant bounding the work of one level per stored bit.
symbols.quote: Each level's own work is $CV$ for a constant $C$, so dividing by $V$ gives $\varphi(u)\le\lambda\varphi(u/\beta)+C$, with $\lambda=R/W$.

symbols.name: level cost ratio
symbols.meaning: The ratio R/W, the cost factor per level.
symbols.quote: Each level's own work is $CV$ for a constant $C$, so dividing by $V$ gives $\varphi(u)\le\lambda\varphi(u/\beta)+C$, with $\lambda=R/W$.

symbols.name: level count
symbols.meaning: The number of levels, each dividing the field width by beta.
symbols.quote: Let $\ell=\log_\beta u$ be the number of levels; $\ell$ levels reach width 1, where a single-digit swap gives $\varphi(1)=O(1)$.

relations.quote: The procedure is applied to each [Address shear](address-shear.md) that a layer (one stage of the transform) produces.
The shear is realized by running the [Linear network with restored auxiliary values](linear-network-exchange.md), whose gates act pointwise on the array.
